description: This script manages database migrations, resets, status checks, and backups for a sports telecast platform. It includes functions for checking database connectivity, executing SQL files, managing migration history, resetting the database, and providing status updates.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints informational messages with green color.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file against the database.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a migration tracking table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been run successfully.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution result of a migration.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all database tables and types, effectively resetting the database.

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays current database status, including table counts and migration history.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a backup dump of the database.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and command options.
